description_en: Configures an auto scaling policy for a multi-session cloud computer. Elastic Desktop Service allows multiple end users to share a cloud computer in a multi-session cloud computer pool. This helps save costs
description_zh: 为多会话云电脑设置自动扩缩策略。多会话云电脑允许多个用户同时连接同一台云电脑，可节省成本
kebab_example: aliyun ecd set-desktop-group-scale-timer --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-group-id dg-2i8qxpv6t1a030000 --scale-timer-infos Type=rise BuyResAmount=5 MaxResAmount=100 LoadPolicy=0 KeepDuration=180000 RatioThreshold=0.85 MinResAmount=5 Cron=0_0_12_0_0_1 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDesktopGroupScaleTimer

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud computer pool
parameters.name: desktop_group_id

element_fields.help_en:
The threshold for the ratio of connected sessions. This parameter is the condition that triggers auto scaling in a multi-session cloud computer pool. Formula:

`Ratio of connected sessions = Number of connected sessions/(Total number of cloud computers × Maximum number of sessions allowed for each cloud computer) × 100%`.

When the specified threshold is reached, new cloud computers are automatically created. When the specified threshold is not reached, idle cloud computers are released
element_fields.help_zh:
会话占用率阈值，用作多会话云电脑池的自动伸缩触发条件。会话占用率的计算公式为：

```会话占用率 = 已绑定会话数 / (云电脑资源总数 × 每台云电脑支持的最大会话数) × 100%```

当会话占用率达到该阈值时，则会新建云电脑；未达到该阈值时，则删除多余的云电脑
element_fields.name: ratio_threshold

element_fields.help_en:
The keep-alive duration of a session after the session is disconnected. Unit: milliseconds. Valid values: 180000 (3 minutes) to 345600000 (4 days). A value of 0 indicates that the session always keeps alive.

If a session is disconnected by the end user or accidentally due to a factor and the end user does not re-establish a connection with the session within the keep-alive duration, the session expires and unsaved data is deleted. If the end user successfully re-establishes a connection with the session within the keep-alive duration, the end user returns to the session and can still access the original data
element_fields.help_zh:
会话断开连接后继续保留的时间。单位为毫秒，取值范围为180000（3分钟）~345600000（4天）。取值为0时，表示始终保留。

当会话因为用户主动断开或因为其他因素意外断开时，从断开的时刻开始计算，若在该保留时长内用户始终未重新建立与该会话的连接，则该会话注销，未保存的数据都将销毁；若在该保留时长内，用户重新建立连接成功，则仍可进入原来的会话，仍可访问对话断开之前的数据
element_fields.name: keep_duration

element_fields.help_en: One option for the auto scaling policy. This option specifies the number of cloud computers that you want to create in the cloud computer pool. Valid values: 0 to 200
element_fields.help_zh: 伸缩策略参数之一：购买云电脑数。取值范围：0~200
element_fields.name: buy_res_amount

element_fields.help_en: One option for the auto scaling policy. This option specifies the minimum number of cloud computers that you must create in the cloud computer pool. Valid values: 0 to 200
element_fields.help_zh: 伸缩策略参数之一：云电脑最小数量。取值范围：0~200
element_fields.name: min_res_amount

element_fields.help_en: One option for the auto scaling policy. This option specifies the maximum number of cloud computers that you can create in the cloud computer pool. Valid values: 0 to 200
element_fields.help_zh: 伸缩策略参数之一：云电脑最大数量。取值范围：0~200
element_fields.name: max_res_amount

element_fields.help_en: The cron expression of the trigger time
element_fields.name: cron

element_fields.help_en:
The load balancing policy for the multi-session cloud computer pool.

Valid values:

- 0: depth-first

- 1: breadth first
element_fields.help_zh: 多会话云电脑池的负载均衡策略
element_fields.name: load_policy

parameters.help_en: The information about the scheduled auto scaling task
parameters.help_zh: 自动扩缩的定时任务信息列表
parameters.name: scale_timer_infos
